code_blocks.content:
Security-Cam Anomaly Timeline

Review shuffled camera cards, mark frames with odd details, then rebuild the true event sequence. Camera clocks may drift, so the clean answer usually needs both timestamps and evidence.

LOCAL CAM REVIEW

Case

How to play

  1. Read each camera card and its burn-in timestamp.
  2. Mark cards that contain a genuinely odd detail.
  3. Move cards until the story sequence makes sense.
  4. Check the sequence, use hints sparingly, then reveal the answer key.

Case score

Reviewer tools

Shuffled camera cards

Drag on desktop or use the move buttons. Your anomaly marks and notes autosave in this browser.

Answer key

Export reviewer handoff

Copy or download your timeline, marked anomalies, notes, and score. Copy only reports verified success when the browser confirms the clipboard contents.
